title: ReseedBarn builds fertilizer linked list without enforcing ascending fertilizer IDs
description: mintFertilizers constructs the fertilizer nextFid linked list (fertFirst, nextFid[prev]=cur, fertLast) assuming fertilizerIds are ascending — a requirement stated only in NatSpec, not enforced in code. Out-of-order input produces a malformed/cyclic linked list.
impact: A malformed fertilizer linked list corrupts Sun fertilizer payout iteration (Beans paid to fertilizer holders in ID order), potentially stranding or mispaying fertilizer. Bounded by trusted upgrade-caller input; Medium.

ite.intent: Form a correct ascending fertilizer linked list during reseed
ite.technique: Ordering enforced only by comment, not by require

ice_chain.exploit_path: init with non-ascending ids -> nextFid chain malformed -> payout iteration breaks
